metadata.title: systemic-tau-formal: Machine-verifiable Systemic Tau (τₛ) and RECD
metadata.description:
systemic-tau-formal v0.1.10 is an open monorepo for machine-checkable formalization and reproducible reference code of the Systemic Tau (τₛ) paradigm and the Discrete Extramental Clock (RECD).

What is new in v0.1.10

  • FeigenbaumSuperstable: termwise logistic superstable roots — unique period-1 r=2; unique strict period-2 r=1+√5; honesty that onset r=3 is not period-2 superstable; period-4 residual characterization and strict exclusion of lower stages.
  • FeigenbaumCascade: existence of a strict period-4 superstable in cascade isolating window [3.498, 3.499] (IVT + exact ℚ residual); secondary residual zero near 3.96 proving uniqueness fails on full (1+√5, 4); conditional uniqueness under StrictMonoOn residual; Horner lower bound certificate for classical Q'>0 input; hybrid cascade R_n (true SS n≤2 + geometric Feigenbaum tail n≥3) with tail ratios → δ_op; free-c operational pack (unique inverse-scale bridge; naive 2/δ fails).
  • Still zero sorry / zero research axiom under SystemicTau/.

Carried from v0.1.9

  • ThresholdFromDelta unique operational f(δ)=c/δ; extended simple candidates; Ontology L0–L3.
  • Lab Feigenbaum pack: non-tent tauReturnFour, logistic scale-ID, C²/Schwarzian algebra, geometric cascade.

Still research-scale

  • Formal discharge of residual mono on the cascade window (Rolle + cleared poly Q' in Lean)
  • True termwise superstable R_n for all n (not hybrid geometric tail)
  • Mathlib C²-open renorm fixed point + free-c without Kendall pin
  • Field-derived continuum return of τₛ; multi-site empirical P1/P4

Companion: PyPI systemictau. Prior corpus DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20576241.

Epistemic honesty: operational thresholds 0.50 / 0.41 remain protocol pins; cascade hybrid tail is geometric construction, not termwise logistic roots for all n.
